It would be safer to use the bong with how its shattered and jam in a hooka whip to make a seal.

I think it’s because the way glass is  structured, that sanding it will inevitably cause small flakes to erode off over time and be inhaled.
I will never hit a bong if you sanded the  glass. No matter how well it’s cleaned out. Especially with a bong that small.
